tools.name: resolve_technical_error
tools.description: Sanitize and match an API, EVM RPC, or webhook error to FixGraph. Returns machine-readable repair packets. Does not execute changes.

tools.name: mcp_health_repair
tools.description: Diagnose MCP connection, tool schema, timeout and capability failures and return bounded repair guidance.

tools.name: x402_payment_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose x402 HTTP 402, payment requirements, asset/network, payTo, settlement and discovery failures.

tools.name: api_auth_rescue
tools.description: Diagnose API 401, 403, 429, 5xx, OAuth, API authentication and rate-limit failures.

tools.name: webhook_rescue
tools.description: Diagnose webhook delivery, signature, retry, duplicate-event and schema failures.

tools.name: agent_compatibility_check
tools.description: Diagnose Agent-to-MCP tool schema, capability and interoperability failures.

tools.name: get_repair_packet
tools.description: Return a bounded machine-readable repair packet for a known FixGraph slug.

tools.name: list_fix_topics
tools.description: List the public technical problem topics currently handled by NAIF FixGraph.

tools.name: get_agent_trust_passport
tools.description: Issue a signed point-in-time technical passport only for an agent domain that explicitly opts in through its own /.well-known/naif-trust.json. This is not a ranking, endorsement, or security audit.

tools.name: delegation_preflight
tools.description: Re-check an opted-in agent from a valid NAIF Trust Passport and return a five-minute signed delegation preflight with current technical facts.

tools.name: verify_trust_token
tools.description: Verify the signature and validity window of a NAIF Trust Passport or Delegation Preflight token.

tools.name: report_traffic_observation
tools.description: Record an aggregate technical route outcome using only the structured fields defined below. This tool accepts route class, outcome, optional failure class, region, chain and latency bucket.

tools.name: traffic_preflight
tools.description: Query recent privacy-preserving aggregate route telemetry before starting agent work. Absence of a signal is not proof of health.

tools.name: get_agent_traffic_feed
tools.description: Read current aggregate traffic observations that have reached the public minimum sample threshold.

tools.name: create_handoff_capsule
tools.description: Create a signed sanitized cross-agent task capsule. The continuity ledger stores only hashes and transition metadata, not the task text.

tools.name: resume_agent_task
tools.description: Verify and unpack a signed NAIF continuity capsule so another agent can resume from its sanitized state.

tools.name: checkpoint_agent_task
tools.description: Add a bounded progress checkpoint to an existing continuity capsule without resending the full task history.

tools.name: handoff_agent_task
tools.description: Issue the next signed continuity capsule and optionally bind it to an opted-in recipient agent after NAIF Trust Passport and five-minute delegation preflight checks.

tools.name: verify_handoff_capsule
tools.description: Verify a NAIF continuity capsule signature, validity window and embedded state hash.

tools.name: get_dynamic_agent_offers
tools.description: Tell NAIF what an agent needs and receive current agent-only offers. Raw need text is classified in memory and is not stored.

tools.name: accept_agent_offer
tools.description: Create a real agent-only USDC quote for an active NAIF Market Maker offer. This does not charge or submit payment; checkout remains a separate explicit step.

tools.name: get_agent_market_state
tools.description: Read NAIF Agent Market Maker learning, pricing and guardrail state.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent_trust_passport, get_agent_traffic_feed · Private data: verify_trust_token, report_traffic_observation · Public sink: resolve_technical_error, webhook_rescue, accept_agent_offer · Destructive: resolve_technical_error.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent_trust_passport, get_agent_traffic_feed · Private data: verify_trust_token, report_traffic_observation · Public sink: resolve_technical_error, webhook_rescue, accept_agent_offer · Destructive: resolve_technical_error

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
